reasons.plausibility: Friction stir processing as a solid-state approach to avoid hot cracking in high-performance alloys is well-studied and broadly credible, although its applicability to the highest-temperature alloys may need confirmation.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of friction stir–repaired specimens versus fusion-welded ones under representative service conditions provides a clear and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: This proposal offers a plausible and focused repair strategy with clear advantages for hard-to-weld, high-value components, making it highly relevant for researchers and industry.
